title: True Residential — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for True Residential.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "True to the Craft." Luxury tier. True Residential brings 70+ years of commercial refrigeration expertise home. Their undercounter refrigerators, beverage centers, and wine storage use the same compressors and build quality found in restaurant equipment. Made in the USA.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Luxury entertainment areas, home bars, wine collectors. Customers who want commercial durability at home.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for True Residential:

• 70+ years of commercial refrigeration heritage — restaurant-proven technology

• Commercial-grade compressors in residential form factor

• Made in the USA — OMeara, Missouri factory

• Stainless interior and exterior — no plastic anywhere

• The undercounter refrigerator professionals buy for their own homes
